Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 32 Cooks River East.pdf

Clause 9.32.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.32.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified  Heritage Items  within the precinct.

Clause 9.32.2 - height_limit (development_control): To mainta in distinctly single storey streetscapes that exist within the precinct.

Clause 9.32.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect groups or runs of buildings which retain their original form including 
roof forms, original detailing and finishes.

Clause 9.32.2 - other (development_control): To preserve the predominantly low density residen tial character of the precinct.

Clause 9.32.2 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): To ensure that  new  development considers all potential impacts to biodiversity.

Clause 9.32.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure that the provision and location of off -street car parking does not 
adversely impact the amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.32.2 - heritage (development_control): To protect the identified values of the Wells Ave nue Heritage Conservation Area 
and the Stanley Street Heritage Conservation Area.
